_instructions: Browser Control limits, read live by the worker on each new browser. max_running_per_app: private browsers running at once across all users. max_running_per_user: running at once for one user, across their chat sessions. A session over either limit is queued and told its position; while anyone waits, an idle browser closes after queued_idle_seconds instead of idle_seconds. max_wait_seconds: how long a queued tool call waits for a browser before it answers that the browser is busy.
